items.title_en: We're releasing the weights of Mistral Large 4
items.title_zh: 发布 Mistral Large 4 的权重
items.summary_en: Mistral AI has released the weights for Mistral Large 4, enabling researchers to run and fine-tune the model locally. This move reduces reliance on hosted APIs and accelerates experimentation, but also brings licensing, safety, and governance considerations to the fore in open-weight AI projects.
items.summary_zh: Mistral Large 4 的权重已对外公开，研究者和开发者可以在本地部署与微调。此举降低对 API 的依赖，促进实验，但也引发许可、安全与治理方面的讨论。

items.title_en: For the first time ever, Google Search is less than 50% of Alphabet's revenue
items.title_zh: 谷歌搜索首次不足 Alphabet 收入的 50%
items.summary_en: Google Search accounted for less than 50% of Alphabet’s revenue for the first time, signaling a broadening of the company’s revenue base into YouTube, Cloud, and other bets. This diversification implies greater resilience but a more complex business mix for investors and strategists.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌搜索首次不足 Alphabet 收入的 50%，意味着公司收入来源正向 YouTube、云服务等领域扩展。这种多元化提升了韧性，但也让投资者与策略制定者面临更复杂的商业结构。

items.title_en: ‘You Are Done’: The letter sent to King by the F.B.I (2014)
items.title_zh: 你完了：FBI 致马丁·路德·金的信（2014）
items.summary_en: The uncensored FBI letter to Martin Luther King Jr. from the 1960s reveals coercive surveillance tactics and personal pressure used to undermine civil rights leadership. The document provides a stark view of how state power interacted with dissent, and its release invites renewed scrutiny of civil liberties in government overreach.
items.summary_zh: 这封未删改的 FBI 信件揭示了上世纪60年代对马丁·路德·金的监控与施压。信件展示了政府权力如何试图压制民权领袖的声音，引发对公民自由与政府越权行为的再关注。

items.title_en: Mexico has a growing fleet of new vehicles from Chinese brands
items.title_zh: 墨西哥中国品牌新车日益增多
items.summary_en: Mexico is seeing a growing fleet of vehicles from Chinese brands, signaling shifts in consumer demand and regional manufacturing links. The trend could influence local jobs, EV adoption, and competition with traditional automakers as supply chains diversify.
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥国内对中国品牌新车的需求与销量持续上升，反映消费者偏好和区域制造联系的变化。这一趋势可能影响本地就业、电动车普及以及与传统汽车制造商的竞争格局。

items.title_en: H.264 Is Magic (2016)
items.summary_en: H.264 Is Magic (2016) analyzes why the H.264 video codec became a de-facto standard, enabling efficient compression, broad hardware support, and widespread adoption. It discusses licensing realities that helped lock in the standard and powered decades of streaming and video apps.
items.summary_zh: H.264 的魔力（2016）解析为何 H.264 成为事实标准、实现高效压缩与广泛的硬件支持。文章还讨论了授权环境如何将该标准锁定并推动多年来的流媒体与视频应用发展。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 成为人工分析智能指数 v5 的新冠军
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Carbon tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, signaling strong performance on a suite of analytical benchmarks. The result helps buyers and researchers gauge which models excel at reasoning and data interpretation as AI evaluation matures.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 在人工分析智能指数 v5 中位居第一，表明其在一组分析基准上的出色表现。该结果为购买方和研究者提供了评估推理与数据解释能力的参考，体现 AI 评估体系的演进。

items.title_en: DoorDash to acquire Instacart
items.title_zh: DoorDash 将收购 Instacart
items.summary_en: DoorDash announced plans to acquire Instacart, creating a larger player in on-demand grocery delivery. The merger could reshape competition, pricing, and last-mile logistics, while triggering antitrust scrutiny and integration challenges for both platforms.
items.summary_zh: DoorDash 宣布收购 Instacart，将打造更强的即时送货生态。合并可能改变市场竞争格局、定价与末端配送效率，同时面临潜在的反垄断审查和整合挑战。

items.title_en: Hackers expose the identities of more than 40k DHS employees
items.title_zh: 黑客披露超过 4 万 DHS 员工身份信息
items.summary_en: Hackers exposed the identities of more than 40,000 DHS employees, raising concerns about public exposure of government personnel data. The breach underscores the need for improved data hygiene, phishing defenses, and tighter access controls.
items.summary_zh: 黑客披露超过 4 万名国土安全部员工身份信息，暴露政府人员数据的公开风险。该事件凸显需要加强数据清理、抵御钓鱼攻击能力以及更严格的访问控制。

items.title_en: The US added a record 20.2 GWh of battery storage in just 3 months
items.title_zh: 美国三个月新增创纪录的 20.2 GWh 电池储能
items.summary_en: The US added a record 20.2 GWh of grid-scale battery storage in three months, signaling rapid growth in storage deployments to support more renewables. This surge reflects policy momentum and project pipelines, while underscoring ongoing challenges like permitting. Expanded storage improves grid reliability and price resilience.
items.summary_zh: 美国在三个月内新增创纪录的 20.2 GWh 电网级储能，显示出对可再生能源的更大支撑力。此波增长反映了政策推动与项目渠道的积压，同时也暴露出许可等持续挑战。扩大储能容量将提升电网可靠性与价格韧性。

items.title_en: Why is this fingerprinting script creating bioweapons?
items.title_zh: 为什么这个指纹脚本会创建生物武器？
items.summary_en: The piece spotlights dual‑use risks in code that touches biology, illustrating how seemingly harmless fingerprinting tools can be repurposed for harmful outcomes. It argues for stronger safety reviews, access controls, and governance around bio‑related automation to curb misuse.
items.summary_zh: 该文聚焦于触及生物领域的代码的双重用途风险，展示了看似无害的指纹脚本如何被误用来制造生物威胁。强调需要加强安全审查、访问控制和对生物相关自动化的治理，以防止滥用。

items.title_en: How Google determines the names for bodies of water in Google Earth (2008)
items.title_zh: Google 如何为地球水体命名（2008 年）
items.summary_en: Google Earth's naming process for bodies of water in 2008 relied on official gazetteers and editorial review, balancing accuracy with user contributions. The policy reveals how large platforms manage geographic naming and data provenance.
items.summary_zh: 2008 年 Google Earth 在水体命名中结合官方名录与编辑审核，平衡准确性与用户贡献。该政策揭示大型平台如何管理地名与数据来源的取舍与管控。

items.title_en: If IPv4 were land
items.title_zh: 若把 IPv4 当成陆地
items.summary_en: IPv4 scarcity is depicted as a shrinking landmass with a fixed coastline of addresses. The piece explains why NATs and address transfers matter, and why IPv6 adoption remains essential for scalable growth. It highlights practical implications for network architects and service providers.
items.summary_zh: 将 IPv4 的稀缺性比作逐渐缩小的陆地，地址空间如同海岸线般有限。文章阐述网络地址转换和地址交易的重要性，以及为什么长期推进 IPv6 对实现可扩展性至关重要，并讨论对网络架构师与服务提供商的实际影响。

items.title_en: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
items.title_zh: Claude Code 会定期将后台代理的对话记录发送给模型
items.summary_en: Claude Code transmits each background agent’s transcripts to its model, raising privacy and data-use concerns for developers. This telemetry behavior highlights how data sharing can impact confidentiality in code tools.
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 会将后台代理的对话记录发送给模型，引发隐私与数据使用方面的担忧。此类遥测行为凸显了代码工具在数据共享方面的潜在风险。

items.title_en: StackOverflow now gets fewer than 1000 questions a month
items.title_zh: Stack Overflow 现每月不到 1000 条问题
items.summary_en: Stack Overflow now reports fewer than 1,000 questions per month, a dramatic drop that signals a major shift in how developers seek help online. The decline could reflect migration to other communities, changes in data collection, or platform strategy.
items.summary_zh: Stack Overflow 现每月提问不足一千条，显示开发者在线求助方式的显著转变。下降可能源于迁移到其他社区、数据收集变化或平台策略调整。

items.title_en: Chained PHP2Shell Exploit Roots 25 Servers, Including US Government Servers
items.title_zh: PHP2Shell 链式利用入侵 25 台服务器，其中包括政府服务器
items.summary_en: A chained PHP2Shell exploit compromised 25 servers, including government systems, demonstrating how multiple vulnerabilities can be stitched together to achieve full control. The post stresses defense-in-depth and timely patching across sectors.
items.summary_zh: 通过一系列漏洞拼接出的 PHP2Shell 链式利用侵入了 25 台服务器，其中还包括政府系统。该报告强调要在各层确保防御深度并及时打补丁以防止横向扩散。

items.title_en: Qwenputer: A functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
items.title_zh: Qwenputer：在 Qwen3.5 内实现的确定性 RISC-V CPU
items.summary_en: Qwenputer reveals a functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU embedded inside Qwen3.5. The project demonstrates hardware-level determinism within a language-model environment, hinting at reproducible compute and new sandboxing possibilities for AI systems.
items.summary_zh: Qwenputer 展示了一个在 Qwen3.5 内部实现的可运行且确定性的 RISC-V CPU。此举表明可以在语言模型环境中进行硬件级别的确定性仿真，为可重复计算和 AI 系统的安全沙箱打开新可能。

items.title_en: Zero click, silent, remote Android DoS
items.title_zh: 零点击静默的远程 Android 拒绝服务攻击
items.summary_en: A zero-click, silent remote DoS vulnerability on Android enables denial-of-service without user interaction, potentially affecting many devices. Exploits could be triggered via crafted traffic or messages, highlighting the urgent need for timely OS patches and mitigations.
items.summary_zh: 一个无需用户交互、静默发生的 Android 远程拒绝服务漏洞，可能影响大量设备。利用方式可能通过特制网络流量或消息触发，凸显了及时打补丁与缓解措施的紧迫性。

items.title_en: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon：谷歌推出的 Gemini 系列新一代模型
items.summary_en: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google's latest in the Gemini family, focusing on efficiency and safety with improved inference and reliability for enterprise apps. It demonstrates ongoing progress in AI model scaling, with Carbon as a more efficient variant for dense workloads.
items.summary_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon 作为谷歌 Gemini 系列的新一代模型，强调在企业应用中的推理效率与安全性提升。该系列继续推动大模型规模化，Carbon 版本在高密度任务中更具效率。

items.title_en: Evidence of a spying operation by ICE against left-wing social movements
items.title_zh: ICE对左翼社会运动实施监视行动的证据
items.summary_en: New documents and whistleblower testimony reveal ICE conducted a sprawling surveillance operation targeting left-wing social movements, leveraging internal data and informants across decades. The findings raise questions about civil liberties, oversight, and the balance between border enforcement and political dissent.
items.summary_zh: 新的文档和告密者证词揭示ICE长期针对左翼社会运动执行大规模监视行动，动用了内部数据和线人。相关证据推动对公民自由、监督机制以及边境执法与政治异议之间平衡的讨论。

items.title_en: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.title_zh: 苹果的 Git 仍信任被妥协的 eMudhra 证书
items.summary_en: Apple's git still trusts compromised eMudhra certificates, leaving room for potential man-in-the-middle attacks on TLS and code signing trust. This highlights how supply chain security depends on up-to-date trust stores, and warrants prompt certificate revocation and rotation.
items.summary_zh: 苹果的 Git 仍信任被妥协的 eMudhra 证书，增加了 TLS 与代码签名信任被滥用的风险。这凸显供应链安全对最新信任存储的依赖，应尽快撤销并轮换相关证书。

items.title_en: Forging a Microsoft Edge Full Chain with Logic Bugs Only
items.title_zh: 仅用逻辑漏洞打造 Edge 全链路利用
items.summary_en: A security researcher demonstrates a full exploit chain for Microsoft Edge using only logic bugs, not memory corruption, challenging assumptions about browser defenses.
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者展示如何仅靠逻辑漏洞就能构建 Edge 的完整利用链，未涉及内存损坏。这一结果挑战了对浏览器防护的部分假设，强调需加强威胁建模与持续的浏览器加固。

items.title_en: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch
items.title_zh: 配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏和触控的 MacBook Pro
items.summary_en: Apple unveils a MacBook Pro featuring a new PROLED XDR display and touch input, promising vibrant color, high brightness, and responsive interaction. The move signals a push toward higher-end display tech and more interactive laptops.
items.summary_zh: 苹果推出搭载全新 PROLED XDR 显示屏与触控输入的 MacBook Pro，承诺带来更丰富的色彩、极高的亮度与灵敏的交互体验，标志着对高端显示技术与触控交互的进一步推进。

items.title_en: Leak Exposes 41,000 Homeland Security Workers–Including Undercover ICE Agents
items.title_zh: 41,000 名国土安全部雇员信息泄露——含卧底 ICE 特工
items.summary_en: A leak exposed the identities of about 41,000 Homeland Security workers, including undercover ICE agents. The breach highlights the brittleness of workforce data protection and the risk to agents’ safety, underscoring the need for stronger access controls and faster remediation.
items.summary_zh: 约41,000名国土安全部雇员的身份信息被泄露，其中包括卧底 ICE 特工。信息泄露暴露了人事数据保护的薄弱环节，强调需要更强的访问控制和快速修复。

items.title_en: A Health Update
items.title_zh: 健康更新
items.summary_en: The author shares a health update, detailing current condition and what it means for upcoming work. They indicate possible temporary slowdowns in publishing while recovering.
items.summary_zh: 作者发布健康更新，详细说明当前状况及对未来工作的影响，并表示在康复期间发表节奏可能会暂时放慢。

items.title_en: CNC Stone Carving
items.title_zh: CNC 石材雕刻
items.summary_en: CNC stone carving blends automation with traditional craftsmanship, enabling precise, repeatable stonework for architecture and sculpture.
items.summary_zh: CNC 石材雕刻将自动化与传统工艺结合，实现建筑与雕塑领域的高精度、可重复加工。内容涵盖工作流、工具选型以及材料要点，以提升雕刻质量。

items.title_en: Emacs Turns 50
items.title_zh: Emacs迎来50周年
items.summary_en: Emacs turns 50, celebrating half a century of extensible, Lisp-based text editing that has influenced code editors and development workflows. Despite aging interfaces, its ecosystem endures through deep customization and a dedicated user base.
items.summary_zh: Emacs迎来50周年，庆祝这款基于 Lisp 的可扩展文本编辑器在代码编辑和开发工作流中的长期影响力。尽管界面相对陈旧，其通过深度定制和忠实用户群体仍保持生态活力。

items.title_en: GitLab Security Incident: Attempted Exploitation of CVE-2026-97229
items.title_zh: GitLab 安全事件：尝试利用 CVE-2026-97229
items.summary_en: GitLab reports an attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-97229 as part of a security incident; patches have been released and admins are urged to upgrade. The incident underscores the ongoing pressure to patch quickly and audit dependencies in CI/CD platforms.
items.summary_zh: GitLab 报告了试图利用 CVE-2026-97229 的攻击行为，相关补丁已发布并敦促管理员尽快升级。此事件凸显在 CI/CD 平台上快速打补丁和审计依赖的持续压力。

items.title_en: Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI
items.title_zh: 肯塔基男子成首位获批就使用AI申请宗教豁免的人文主义者
items.summary_en: A Kentucky humanist obtained a religious exemption to use AI, marking a notable legal milestone in how religious beliefs intersect with workplace AI policies. The decision signals how courts and regulators may rethink AI usage rules in diverse belief systems.
items.summary_zh: 肯塔基一位人文主义者获得了使用 AI 的宗教豁免，这是宗教信仰与工作场所 AI 使用规则交叉的一个重要里程碑。此举可能推动对 AI 使用政策在不同信仰体系中的再考量。

items.title_en: Formlabs Studio 1 $699 Resin Printer
items.title_zh: Formlabs Studio 1：699美元树脂打印机
items.summary_en: Formlabs launches Studio 1, a $699 resin 3D printer aimed at hobbyists and education. It adds a low-cost entry point to Formlabs' lineup, potentially expanding access to high-resolution SLA prints.
items.summary_zh: Formlabs 推出 Studio 1，售价699美元的树脂3D打印机，面向爱好者与教育市场。此举为 Formlabs 的产品线带来更低的入门门槛，可能让高分辨率树脂打印更易于普及到工作室和课堂。

items.title_en: Meta censored the No Kings Instagram account during a nationwide campaign
items.title_zh: Meta 在全国性活动中屏蔽 No Kings 的 Instagram 账号
items.summary_en: Meta censored the No Kings Instagram account amid a nationwide campaign, illustrating the ongoing friction between platform policies and political outreach. The move underscores how moderation decisions can shape public messaging during large-scale operations and invites discussion about transparency and consistency.
items.summary_zh: Meta 在全国性活动中屏蔽 No Kings 的 Instagram 账号，揭示平台政策与政治传播之间的持续博弈。此举凸显审核决策对大规模活动中的信息传播影响，并引发对透明度与一致性的讨论。

items.title_en: Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments
items.title_zh: 日常工作：税务——在 50 项专业税务任务上评估 AI 代理
items.summary_en: Evaluates how AI agents perform across 50 real-world tax assignments, highlighting gaps in professional tax reasoning, document handling, and compliance checks. The findings matter for how automation reshapes knowledge work, raising questions about accuracy and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 对 AI 代理在 50 项真实税务任务中的表现进行评估，揭示专业税务推理、文档处理和合规检查方面的不足。结果影响自动化如何改变专业工作FLOW，并引发对准确性与问责制的讨论。

items.title_en: Wealth Inequality in America drawn to scale
items.title_zh: 美国财富不平等被放大呈现
items.summary_en: A visualization-driven project layers data to show how wealth concentrates at the very top of the US economy, with stark gaps across households. The work underscores how tech platforms and policymakers must consider real distributions when shaping products and policies.
items.summary_zh: 一个以可视化为核心的项目揭示美国经济中财富高度集中的现状，以及家庭之间的巨大差距。此类呈现为科技平台与政策制定者在设计产品与制定政策时提供了对真实分布的直观认知。

items.title_en: AlpineBSD
items.title_zh: AlpineBSD
items.summary_en: AlpineBSD presents a BSD‑based distribution focused on security and simplicity in a compact footprint, aiming to bring BSD’s philosophy to users seeking streamlined, secure systems.
items.summary_zh: AlpineBSD 提供一个基于 BSD 的发行版，强调安全与简洁，体积小、适合追求高效与安全的用户。

items.title_en: Git for the US Code
items.title_zh: 用 Git 管理美国法典
items.summary_en: Versioning the US Code with Git shows how large legal texts can be edited transparently and auditable over time. The piece weighs practical challenges—structure, numbering, and edition standards—and points to developer-style workflows (PRs, diffs) as a path to more collaborative lawmaking.
items.summary_zh: 用 Git 对美国法典进行版本控制展示了大型法文本如何实现可追溯、透明的编辑过程。文章评估了结构、编号和版本标准等实际挑战，并探讨了采用开发者工作流（合并请求、变更对比）以促进协作式修订的可能性。

items.title_en: Google AI gets cagey when asked who won the 2020 elections
items.title_zh: 谷歌 AI 被问及2020年大选结果时显得谨慎
items.summary_en: Google's AI dodges questions about who won the 2020 elections, reflecting policy constraints and concerns about misinformation. The moment highlights how language models handle politically sensitive queries and the balance between truthfulness and safety policies.
items.summary_zh: 当被问及2020年大选结果时，谷歌的 AI 选择回避，反映出相关政策约束与对误导信息的担忧。此情景揭示大型语言模型在政治敏感问题上的处理取舍，以及真相与安全策略之间的平衡。

items.title_en: Survival LLM: AI assistant and emergency library that runs on your own computer
items.title_zh: Survival LLM：可在本地运行的 AI 助手与应急知识库
items.summary_en: Survival LLM provides an AI assistant and an offline knowledge library that runs entirely on your own computer. This design emphasizes privacy, resilience, and disaster-scenario readiness, letting teams access critical information without cloud dependence.
items.summary_zh: Survival LLM 提供一个可在本地运行的 AI 助手和应急知识库，完全在本地计算机上运作。此设计强调隐私与韧性，支持在没有云端的情况下访问关键信息，提升灾害情景下的可用性。

items.title_en: Archive.today links going forward
items.title_zh: Archive.today 链接将进入新阶段
items.summary_en: Archive.today announced changes to how its links work going forward, signaling shifts in archiving behavior and access. The update may impact researchers relying on stable snapshots and could influence how citations reference preserved content in the future.
items.summary_zh: Archive.today 宣布将对链接的工作方式进行调整，标志着存档行为的变化。此举可能影响依赖稳健快照的研究人员，以及在引用受保内容时的可追溯性。

items.title_en: US agency approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar
items.title_zh: 美国机构批准亚马逊 Leo 115亿美元收购 Globalstar
items.summary_en: US regulators approve Amazon Leo's $11.5B acquisition of Globalstar, accelerating Amazon's satellite and IoT ambition. The deal could bolster global connectivity services, from backhaul to disaster resilience, while raising antitrust and spectrum-use questions.
items.summary_zh: 美国监管机构批准亚马逊 Leo 115 亿美元收购 Globalstar，加速了亚马逊在卫星与物联网领域的野心。交易可能提升全球连接能力，并引发反垄断与频谱使用方面的讨论。

items.title_en: Leak website releases data on DHS employees
items.title_zh: 泄漏网站公开数万名国土安全部雇员资料
items.summary_en: A leak site published tens of thousands of DHS employees' data, raising privacy and security concerns. The release could expose undercover workers and disrupt agency operations.
items.summary_zh: 一个泄漏网站公开数万名国土安全部员工的资料，带来隐私与安全方面的担忧。该信息可能暴露 undercover 工作者并影响机构的数据治理与应急响应。

items.title_en: Two high-speed trains collide near Toledo, Spain
items.title_zh: 西班牙托莱多附近两列高铁相撞
items.summary_en: Two high-speed trains collided near Toledo, Spain, with casualties and a wrecked scene captured in initial footage. Investigations will focus on signaling, safety protocols, and emergency response, with potential implications for Europe’s rail safety standards.
items.summary_zh: 西班牙托莱多附近两列高速列车相撞，造成人员伤亡，现场残骸初步画面已公开。调查将聚焦信号系统、安全规程与应急响应，或对欧洲铁路安全标准产生影响。

items.title_en: Tailscale SSH: Investigation and remediation update
items.title_zh: Tailscale SSH：调查进展与整改更新
items.summary_en: Tailscale has published an investigation update on a security incident affecting its SSH feature. The update outlines the root cause, affected components, and remediation steps, including patches and credential rotation. The incident underscores the importance of timely updates and access-control hygiene in zero-trust environments.
items.summary_zh: Tailscale 已发布关于影响其 SSH 功能的安全事件调查更新。更新概述了根本原因、受影响的组件与整改措施，包括补丁与凭证轮换。此事件凸显在零信任环境中及时更新和访问控制的重要性。

items.title_en: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
items.title_zh: 使用 Claude 加速药物开发的初步进展
items.summary_en: Early results show Claude assisting with drug development tasks such as literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, and experimental design. While promising, the work highlights ongoing questions about reliability, regulatory compliance, and the need for human oversight in AI-augmented drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 初步结果显示 Claude 能协助药物开发任务，如文献综述、假设生成和实验设计。前景虽乐观，但也暴露在可靠性、监管合规性，以及 AI 辅助药物发现需人类监督等方面的持续问题。

items.title_en: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware threatens most servers on planet Earth
items.title_zh: 全球大多数服务器的UEFI固件代码执行漏洞
items.summary_en: A critical code-execution vulnerability in UEFI firmware could allow attackers to run arbitrary code before the OS loads, potentially compromising most servers worldwide. Vendors will need to release firmware patches and implement mitigations, and admins should plan an update window.
items.summary_zh: UEFI 固件中的一处关键代码执行漏洞可能在操作系统加载前执行任意代码，威胁全球多数服务器。厂商需发布固件补丁并实施缓解措施，管理员应安排更新窗口。

items.title_en: About the compromised eMudhra intermediate CAs
items.title_zh: 关于 eMudhra 中级证书被妥协
items.summary_en: An advisory notes that eMudhra's intermediate Certificate Authorities were compromised, prompting revocation and reissuance guidance. The incident highlights PKI trust risks and the need for organizations to monitor certificates and update trust stores across devices.
items.summary_zh: 公告称 eMudhra 的中级证书遭到妥协，建议撤销并重新颁发。此事件凸显公钥基础设施的信任风险，促使组织加强证书生命周期管理与设备信任库更新。

items.title_en: The Agent SDK
items.title_zh: 代理 SDK
items.summary_en: Introduces a software development kit aimed at building autonomous agents with tool usage and planning capabilities. The SDK accelerates experimentation while prompting questions about safety, governance, and integration with existing tools.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个面向构建具工具使用与规划能力的自动代理的开发工具包。该 SDK 能加速实验，但也带来安全、治理以及与现有工具集整合的讨论。

items.title_en: Discord will soon let anyone find public server messages through Google
items.title_zh: Discord 即将允许通过 Google 搜索公开服务器消息
items.summary_en: Discord plans to make content from discoverable servers indexable by Google, improving discoverability but raising moderation and privacy concerns.
items.summary_zh: Discord 将使公开服务器的内容可被 Google 索引，提升可发现性，但也引发监管与隐私方面的担忧。

items.title_en: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: open ASR for 40 languages
items.title_zh: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe：40 种语言的开源 ASR
items.summary_en: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe brings open-source ASR to 40 languages, lowering the barrier for multilingual speech applications. The release lets researchers compare performance against other open models and accelerates progress in open speech AI.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 为40种语言提供开源自动语音识别，降低多语言语音应用的门槛。该发布使研究者能够与其它开源模型进行对比，加速开放语音 AI 的进展。

items.title_en: Raspberry Pi Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A spotted in device trees
items.title_zh: 在设备树中发现 Raspberry Pi Zero 3W 与 Pi 4 Model A
items.summary_en: Device tree entries hint at two new Raspberry Pi models: Zero 3W and Pi 4 Model A. If launched, they would extend the ultra-accessible, low-power lineup with new specs and price points, affecting hobbyists and edge deployments.
items.summary_zh: 设备树中出现 Raspberry Pi Zero 3W 与 Pi 4 Model A 的迹象。若推出，将拓展极具性价比的低功耗阵容，并带来新的规格与定价，或影响爱好者与边缘计算场景。

items.title_en: Four Months of Zig
items.title_zh: 四个月的 Zig：一段学习与实践之路
items.summary_en: Four months into exploring Zig, the author shares hands-on experiences with its tooling, portability, and performance characteristics. The write-up weighs Zig’s advantages in simplicity and control against ecosystem maturity and library support.
items.summary_zh: 在学习 Zig 的四个月里，作者分享了对工具链、可移植性和性能的实际体验。文中评估了 Zig 在简洁性与可控性方面的优势，以及生态成熟度与库支持方面的挑战。

items.title_en: Hunger beats tenure: Advice for junior engineers
items.title_zh: 饥饿感胜过任期：给初级工程师的建议
items.summary_en: Hunger beats tenure offers practical guidance for junior engineers to prioritize impact and continuous learning over staying safe in a comfortable job. It advocates grabbing ownership, shipping early, seeking feedback, and building a strong track record to accelerate growth.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章为初级工程师提供实用建议，强调把影响力和持续学习放在优先位置，而非追求安稳的任期。倡导主动承担责任、早日落地、积极寻求反馈，并建立可验证的成长记录来加速职业发展。
